title: GAURAVSHARMALINUX/cats-vs-dogs-mlops
description: End-to-end MLOps pipeline for Cats vs Dogs binary image classification: DVC-versioned data, MLflow experiment tracking, a FastAPI inference service, Docker packaging, and GitHub Actions CI/CD that deploys to an ephemeral kind cluster gated by a smoke test and a post-deployment accuracy check. MLOps (S1-25_AIMLCZG523) Assignment 2.
